title: The quasi-finite locus of a finite type ring map is open
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. In $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the set $Q=\{\mathfrak q\subset B: A\to B\text{ is quasi-finite at }\mathfrak q\}$, with quasi-finiteness at a prime as in [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime], is open. Equivalently, for each $\mathfrak q\in Q$ there is $g\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that $A\to B_g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is quasi-finite at every prime of $B_g$.

proof.text: For a quasi-finite prime q, apply Algebra.exists_finite_subalgebra_away_of_isQuasiFiniteAtPrime to obtain a finite A-subalgebra B' and g in B' outside q with a bijective canonical map B'_g to B_g. This is the finite-subalgebra construction in the source proof.

proof.text: Install the supplied Module.Finite A B' instance. Mathlib.RingTheory.QuasiFinite.Basic provides QuasiFinite A B' from module finiteness and QuasiFinite A (Localization.Away g) by localization. Apply Algebra.QuasiFinite.of_surjective_algHom to Localization.awayMapₐ B'.val g and the supplied surjectivity. This gives QuasiFinite A B_g. The finite-type instance for B_g is supplied by Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.InvSubmonoid. QuasiFinite makes each residue-field fibre an Artinian ring, hence its prime spectrum discrete; isOpen_discrete proves the defining open singleton at every prime of B_g. All these are applications of proved Mathlib instances and one proved Mathlib theorem, with no unproved intermediate result.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00QA, label lemma-quasi-finite-open, proof; Lemma Tag 077H, label lemma-quasi-finite-local, proof

proof.text: Let i be the contraction map Spec B_g to Spec B. Its open embedding is PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_isOpenEmbedding, the underlying topological assertion of the principal-localization open immersion. Scalar-tower compatibility identifies the localized fibre with the inverse image under i of the original fibre. Restrict the open embedding to that fibre, using IsOpenEmbedding.restrictPreimage and Homeomorph.setCongr. Its image of the distinguished singleton is the singleton at the contracted point. IsOpenEmbedding.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen now sends an open localized singleton to an open original singleton. The private helper isQuasiFiniteAtPrime_comap_away writes this elementary open-subspace argument in Lean.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00QA, label lemma-quasi-finite-open, proof; Lemma Tag 077H, label lemma-quasi-finite-local, proof

proof.text: For each q in the locus choose g from step 1. The point q lies in the basic open D(g). PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range identifies D(g) with the range of i, so every point there contracts from a localized prime. Steps 2 and 4 put all these points in the locus. Apply PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.isOpen_iff to obtain openness. The local witnesses are already constructed for every quasi-finite point, so both sides of the displayed equivalence hold; combine them with the openness assertion by conjunction introduction.
